title: Intent-aware JSON parameter validator and recoverable error frames
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem: As teams adopt tool/function calling via the core API, we see two recurring issues: 1) rigid schema rejections for small shape mismatches (e.g., number vs numeric-string, missing optional fields), and 2) opaque error messages that are hard for engineers and end-user developers to act on. This ticket defines and implements an "intent-aware" validation pipeline that: a) specifies a compact JSON schema dialect for function parameters (subset of JSON Schema + a small set of Redwood extensions), b) performs staged validation with graded error levels (coercion, advisory, hard-fail), c) emits structured, human-friendly error frames with recovery suggestions, and d) supports streaming/partial validation for long-running streaming responses to surface issues early.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc that defines the validator DSL: allowed keywords, coercion rules, and Redwood extensions (max 4 pages)
Runtime implementation behind feature flag that enforces staged validation and returns structured error frames when applicable
Error frame schema published and documented in API reference; includes machine-readable code, severity, human_hint, suggested_fix, and optional examples
Compatibility adaptor that maps legacy 'param hints' used by older SDKs to the new DSL
End-to-end tests covering coercion paths, streaming partial validation, and regression tests for existing tool call contracts
Performance: p50 validation overhead per call < 8ms on typical dedicated instance; p99 < 25ms for non-pathological shapes
comments: 2026-03-01 - Avery Chen: Initial RFC posted to Confluence (link in attachments). Proposal favors a small JSON Schema subset + 'x-intent' extension instead of full Draft-2020 to keep runtime small.

2026-03-03 - Ravi Patel: Architecture review done. Agreed to implement three validation modes: STRICT (current behavior), COERCE (try safe coercions), and ADVISORY (report but return result). Added feature flag for gradual rollout.
2026-03-05 - Leah Morales (Design): UX review — error frames must include a short human_hint (one sentence) and an example 'before/after' JSON when coercion is suggested.
2026-03-06 - SRE (Ben K.): Flagging perf risk on p99 for very large objects. Action: add payload size gating and fallback to async validation for >1MB parameter blobs.

2026-03-08 - Ravi Patel: Implemented prototype validator and created PR #3421. Benchmark dashboard link in attachments. Prototype covers number<->string coercion, date ISO coercion, and boolean coercion heuristics.
2026-03-09 - PM feedback (Maya R.): Request to expose validation_mode at the route level via console and API; also requested telemetry for 'recovery suggestions accepted' metric.
2026-03-10 - Ravi Patel: Addressed review comments, added compatibility adaptor for SDK <v1.9, and updated acceptance criteria with performance targets. Next: security review and integration tests.
